what_happened.line: The Finance Committee took no budget votes; it heard a member's 11-year analysis of new growth and how it feeds the levy and free cash.
The committee decided to pursue no policy on new growth, to keep flexibility.
The business manager reported that the free cash balance sheet went to the state for certification, and that personal property growth ran above the estimate.
The business manager will ask the assessor how much residential new growth comes from improvements and how much from new homes.
Only the minutes were approved, though the outcome of that vote is not audible, and the meeting then adjourned.

why_it_matters: New growth that comes in above the amount budgeted flows to free cash or special town meeting appropriations, so it shapes how much one-time money is available and what the levy can support.
A member raised that police staffing may need more than a one-per-year plan, which could affect next year's budget and tax bills.
